claim: Downside-floor stress: at 6.65x-8.0x (the FY2014-FY2017 trough range of Airtel's own EV/EBITDA on a pre-lease basis) applied to annualised India SA EBITDAaL of INR 91,150 crore, less India net debt ex leases (INR 69,314 crore) and Indus/Hexacom NCI at market, plus the Airtel Africa stake at market, equity value is INR 915-1,113 per share (-49% to -37%); with a 15% EBITDAaL cut and a 50% Africa haircut it is INR 685-853 per share.
